purpose: Improve observed local rainfall, independently of fantasy zone and temperature scores

new_geographic_validation.policy: Freeze regions before looking at candidate results; evaluate baseline and the selected candidate once; require mean rainfall loss and monthly MAE not to increase. These regions must not be used for subsequent tuning and still described as fresh validation.

publication: Passing these development gates does not itself update atlas climates; the mean three-layout native atlas must also be regenerated and verified.
